decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding to boost the power and effectiveness of its creatures and spells. It also includes a mix of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Scion of Draco, and Territorial Kavu to apply pressure on the opponent. Tribal Flames and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker add additional versatility and reach to the deck, while Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial provide removal and protection. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's diverse color requirements.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly using Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to ramp into powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End. It also utilizes Blade of the Bloodchief to power up creatures like Glaring Fleshraker, enabling them to deal massive damage. Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command provide removal and disruption, while Writhing Chrysalis can create additional threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of ramp, powerful creatures, and disruptive spells to secure victory in a fast-paced Modern format.

This deck focuses on controlling the board and manipulating the opponent's resources through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card draw. The key strategy is to establish early control with cards like Lórien Revealed and Leyline of the Guildpact, followed by utilizing powerful creatures like Scion of Draco and Solitude to maintain pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes versatile spells like Fire / Ice and Force of Negation to handle a variety of threats. Overall, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent for a strategic victory.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counter spells, hand disruption, and removal. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation, the deck aims to control the board and limit the opponent's resources. Additionally, cards like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus provide threats that can quickly close out the game once the opponent's resources have been exhausted. Overall, the key strategy of this deck is to outlast the opponent and win through attrition.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of creatures and spells to quickly overpower the opponent. Key cards include Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding to control the board, Lightning Bolt for direct damage, and powerful creatures like Scion of Draco and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to close out the game. Consign to Memory provides additional flexibility and card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive playstyle with a mix of lands that provide various colors of mana.

This deck focuses on utilizing Leyline cards to control the board and pump up creatures with Leyline of the Guildpact. It also includes powerful aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to quickly establish a board presence and deal damage efficiently through a combination of pump spells and burn spells like Lightning Bolt. The mana base allows for flexibility in casting spells of multiple colors, giving the deck a versatile and aggressive edge in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and lands like Gruul Turf and Simic Growth Chamber to quickly generate mana and search for key combo pieces like Scapeshift and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The goal is to ramp up quickly, establish a board presence with powerful lands, and then combo off by searching for and activating Valakut's ability to deal lethal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes ways to protect its combo pieces and generate additional value through cards like Summoner's Pact and Cultivator Colossus.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's plans through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. The goal is to control the game by constantly disrupting the opponent's plays and gradually gaining advantage through card advantage and tempo. The deck includes powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. The mana base is designed to support the control game plan efficiently and consistently. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent through careful resource management and disruption.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to play big Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also utilizes control elements like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi creatures while controlling the board and resource management with cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Ugin's Labyrinth. By ramping up and controlling the game, this deck aims to dominate the battlefield and secure victory.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's resources and controlling the board through a combination of removal spells, board wipes, and exile effects. It aims to outvalue the opponent with powerful creatures like Solitude and Skyclave Apparition, while also utilizing cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Relic of Progenitus to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also has a land destruction sub-theme with cards like Field of Ruin and Ghost Quarter to further disrupt the opponent's mana base. The overall strategy is to control the game and outlast the opponent until victory.

The deck focuses on aggressively using a combination of efficient creatures like Phlage, Ocelot Pride, and Ragavan, while also utilizing burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The deck also includes some control elements like Static Prison and Thraben Charm to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Arena of Glory provide additional support and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and consistent aggression while controlling the board to secure victory.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Snapcaster Mage. The deck also has card advantage with Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Psychic Frog. The mana base allows for flexibility in casting spells of all colors, while also providing some utility lands. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a board presence and eventually winning the game through attrition.

This deck focuses on quickly playing low-cost creatures and spells to apply constant pressure on the opponent, utilizing cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Monastery Swiftspear, and Lightning Bolt to deal damage efficiently. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help with card selection and manipulation, while Lava Dart and Mutagenic Growth provide additional versatility in combat. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early on by maintaining a steady stream of threats and control elements, utilizing the UR color combination for a balance of aggression and disruption.

The main focus of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly establish board presence and deal direct damage to the opponent using cheap and efficient creatures and spells. The deck includes cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off to apply pressure early on, while also utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to finish off opponents. The inclusion of Dragon's Rage Channeler and Expressive Iteration helps to maintain card advantage and keep the pressure on the opponent. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggression and efficient card advantage.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Broodscale Bloodchief and various support cards to quickly overwhelm and defeat the opponent. By utilizing cards like Walking Ballista, Eldrazi Temple, and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to generate incredible value and create an unbeatable board state. The inclusion of cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Malevolent Rumble further enhances the deck's ability to control the game and push towards victory. With a well-executed strategy, this deck can achieve victory in a fast and decisive manner.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to apply constant pressure on the opponent with a low-to-the-ground aggressive strategy. It aims to quickly deploy threats like Monastery Swiftspear and Cori-Steel Cutter while utilizing efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Mutagenic Growth to eliminate opposing threats and finish the game quickly. The deck also includes card draw spells like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to maintain card advantage and consistency. By focusing on early aggression and efficient removal, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.
